label: P2 of the definitional argument (weak): whatever has been defined is true
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the owner-specified premise 'whatever is defined is true' in its weak version (attribution deferred): every description that has been introduced by a definitional act in the frame is satisfied by some object. It is restricted to descriptions actually defined; it does not say which descriptions may be defined. Its unrestricted version is the unrestricted characterization principle.
